mis_maquinas.texto: Learn how to add, modify, and manage your registered machines.
mis_maquinas.detalle: From the My Machines section, you can view all registered machines. To add a new one, use the add button and complete the requested information, such as name, brand, serial number, and status. You can also access each machine to modify its information or delete it.

mantenimientos.texto: Learn how to register maintenance, update information, and check machine status.
mantenimientos.detalle: In the Maintenance section, you can view machine information and register the corresponding data for a maintenance task. You can enter the date, description, and machine status, and then save the changes.

historial.texto: View previously completed changes and maintenance tasks.
historial.detalle: The History section allows you to view previous records. There you can review information changes and maintenance associated with the machines to see what modifications were made.

configuracion.texto: Modify the system options and preferences.
configuracion.detalle: From Settings, you can manage the general system preferences and adjust the available options to adapt its operation to the user's needs.

como_agregar_maquina.pregunta: How do I add a machine?
como_agregar_maquina.respuesta: Go to the My Machines section from the side menu and select Add Machine. Complete the name, type, brand, serial number, and initial status. Finally, save the changes.

como_modificar_maquina.pregunta: How do I modify the information of a machine?
como_modificar_maquina.respuesta: Open the machine from My Machines and select the option to edit its information. Once you have made the changes, save them to update the information.

como_eliminar_maquina.pregunta: How do I delete a machine?
como_eliminar_maquina.respuesta: From My Machines, select the machine you want to delete and choose the Delete option. Keep in mind that this action cannot be undone.

como_registrar_mantenimiento.respuesta: Go to the Maintenance section from the side menu. Complete the required information, such as date, description, and status, and then select Update to save the information.

como_cambiar_estado.pregunta: How do I change the status of a machine?
como_cambiar_estado.respuesta: Open the machine from My Machines or Maintenance and select the appropriate status: Operational, Not Operational, or Under Maintenance.

donde_consultar_mantenimientos.pregunta: Where can I view previous maintenance records?
donde_consultar_mantenimientos.respuesta: Go to the History section to view previous records and review the changes and maintenance performed on the machines.
